unit.why: A sequence of short homilies and verse/Talmud interpretations attributed to the rebbe (Avot, Torah portions, Psalms, Proverbs, Megillah, Sanhedrin, Grace after Meals). The only quasi-narrative elements do not stand as stories: a question-and-answer exchange with R. Pinhas of Ostrog, and the Talmudic tale of Pinhas ben Yair, which is quoted as a text to be explained.
unit.boundary_note: The last teaching (on Pinhas ben Yair and Moses) breaks off at 'ותירץ' and continues into the next division. Its answer includes an anecdote about the Beit Yosef and his maggid, which should be assessed there.
